items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: I learned Poinnell how to play piano.

ctx.x: On the riverside and on the downtown.

Yeah, that's it. Take a picture of it that was downtown. Yeah, Orleans Pleasure Club, that was Orleans Pleasure Club. Did you put on parades too? No, I never did on parades. No, no, no, no, just parties. I never tried to make a second line in my life. Really? I never did. I never did. When the parades be coming, the parades be over there, I go over here. I never did like a second line on a parade, I don't know why. But they used to have them. Yes, and when I was in the PWA band, I don't know where they got so…
Oh yeah, I had to Poinnell. I had to Poinnell.
